# Perplexity API changelog (literal entry list)
# Captured 2026-10-06 from https://docs.perplexity.ai/changelog
# NOTE: store the LITERAL entry list here, never a prose summary.

## October 2026
Decisions API — answers questions about text, JSON, or images with PROBABILITIES instead of
  generated text. POST https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/decisions, model pplx-decider-v1-27b.
  Question types: bool (yes/no probability), choice (one of N + per-option probability),
  score (ordered rubric + expected score). $0.04 / M input tokens, output free.
  docs: https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/decisions/quickstart
Native document support — Agent API processes PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, RTF directly via
  `input_file` content; inline uploads AND public HTTPS URLs (server-side fetch).
Image Search tool — new `image_search` tool, filters for domain, format, safe-search.
  $2.50 per 1,000 successful invocations.
Sandbox extraction tracking — Agent API responses include token usage and cost for
  pplx_sdk.llm.extract calls inside the sandbox tool environment.
Fast Search expansion — low/medium/high presets switched to Fast Search; web_search
  $2.50 -> $1.00 per 1,000 invocations, ~800ms faster.

## September 2026
Model updates — GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash.
